'''Jorelle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She made her living as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] on board [[Carrick Station]].

==Behind the scenes==
Jorelle first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Coruscant planetary commendation vendor on board Carrick Station. She was later relabeled as the Level 13 Equipment Vendor, though she was later removed along with the rest of the planetary Equipment Vendors in Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]].
